name: HarryPotterObamaSonic10Inu
rootCause: A series of exploiting transactions on Ethereum targeting the liquidity pool of the HarryPotterObamaSonic10Inu 2.0 token. The attacker profited approximately $243K and deposited the funds into Tornado.

descriptions.text: A series of exploiting transactions on Ethereum targeting the liquidity pool of the HarryPotterObamaSonic10Inu 2.0 token. The attacker profited approximately $243K and deposited the funds into Tornado.

HarryPotterObamaSonic10Inu was exploited on Ethereum mainnet on December 18, 2024. The attacker manipulated the spot price in the token's liquidity pool through repeated large liquidity operations, draining about $243,000 in ETH. The contract's reliance on manipulable spot pricing and ineffective access control allowed the exploit. The liquidity pool contract accepted spot price from immediate pool reserve ratios, and lacked robust access controls for high-volume liquidity operations.
